facts.fact: The Immigration and Citizenship Service's presentation states that civil registration is mainly paper-based and manual, with three copies of the vital events form passing from the kebele office to the woreda office and on to ICS; no date is given, so the presentation's date is used.

The Immigration and Citizenship Service states that a tablet-based ME-CRVS system has been piloted in 1,300 kebeles and health facilities, in a country it counts at 19,202 kebeles of which 70% provide civil registration services; no date is given, so the presentation's date is used.

The Immigration and Citizenship Service states that home-grown digital systems in Oromia and Amhara and open-source ones at federal level and in Addis Ababa have been piloted in different parts of the country, as fragmented multiple systems, and gives no count of offices; no date is given, so the presentation's date is used.
facts.system: home-grown (Oromia, Amhara) and open-source (federal, Addis Ababa) digital CR systems

facts.fact: The presentation states that the Immigration and Citizenship Service leads, coordinates, supports and monitors civil registration in all regions, and that the government has decided to standardise the digital CR system throughout the country; no date is given, so the presentation's date is used.
The presentation lists Ethiopia's National CRVS strategic plan (2022-2026) as part of the policy framework, without saying whether it names a digital system; the presentation's date is used.

The presentation states that the Civil and Family Registration Proclamation issued in March 2025 recognises hybrid manual and digital registration and allows vital events to be registered at the place of occurrence, including health facilities.

The presentation states that kebele offices providing civil registration services fell from 90% to 70% of kebeles because of conflict in different parts of the country; the fall is not dated, so the presentation's date is used, and it concerns registration services as a whole, not digital entry.
